region.title: Your account region
region.separate_accounts: Each region has its own account, friends and progress. The server is selected automatically for your account.
region.ru.description: Russian-language servers in Russia. Sign in through VK ID, OK or Mail.ru.
region.global.description: International servers and the omoba.io account.
region.error.save: Could not save your account region. Check that the app can save settings and try again.
region.restart.title: Restart to switch accounts
region.restart.body: Your other region and its account will open after restarting OMOBA. Your current profile and progress stay in their own region. On a phone, close the app and open it again.
